urltestdata.json is a selection of the URL test data of the web platform
tests: url/resources/urltestdata.json of
https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt at commit
065d99ab62bf0b6ca04907f423625801c350edb2 (2026-11-12).

The selection keeps the 357 cases whose input starts with http:// or
https://, in any case of letters: the only ones the rules of this package
can accept. Each case is unchanged, with the characters outside ASCII
written as JSON escapes; the comments between cases are left out.

It is used by the tests of this package and is not part of the binary.
The licence of the original follows.
